title: EVGA 1080 Ti
description: A reminder of a better era for PC hardware. The 1080 Ti was The Golden Age of components.

title: EVGA 2080 Ti
description: The first generation of RTX. A new era of graphics technology, with the 80-tier cards carrying a serious premium. We thought prices could only get better from here.

title: Gigabyte 3080 Ti
description: The beginning of a difficult period for PC hardware pricing. Mining demand and the COVID supply shortages pushed GPU prices to new heights.

title: PNY 4080 Ti
description: The fourth generation of RTX. Prices showed little sign of returning to normal, despite hopes that the market would eventually settle.

title: ASUS 5080 ProArt
description: The new reality of graphics cards. High pricing has become the norm with fake frames increasingly part of the story. The ProArt edition at least makes it look pretty.

title: NVIDIA 5090
description: NVIDIA flagship consumer graphics card. The top of the RTX 50 Series, with a price tag to match. Expensive, difficult to find, and firmly in a league of its own.

title: NVIDIA RTX 4090
description: The previous generation flagship. An absolute powerhouse that made 4K gaming and high-end rendering look easy. Only slightly less ridiculous than the 5090.

title: ASUS RTX 5070 Ti
description: A strong upper-midrange contender from the RTX 50 Series. Modern rendering features, impressive performance and another generation of increasingly expensive graphics cards.

title: MSI RTX 5070
description: The mainstream entry into the RTX 50 Series. A capable card for modern gaming, bringing the latest NVIDIA features to a wider audience.

title: Gigabyte RTX 5060 Ti
description: The more affordable RTX 50 Series option. Designed for mainstream gaming, with modern features and a considerably less intimidating price tag.

title: Sapphire RX 9070 XT
description: AMD's RDNA 4 generation makes a serious attempt at the high-performance market. A competitive gaming GPU with plenty of horsepower.

title: PowerColor RX 7900 XTX
description: AMD's previous flagship. A monster of a graphics card with 24GB of VRAM and enough raw performance to challenge the best.

title: AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D
description: One of the most celebrated gaming processors ever made. Its 3D V-Cache technology made it a favourite among PC gaming enthusiasts.

title: AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D
description: The next generation of gaming performance. AMD's Zen 5 architecture combined with 3D V-Cache to deliver an impressive gaming processor.

title: AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D
description: A flagship desktop processor combining 16 cores with 3D V-Cache. Built for people who want serious gaming and productivity performance.

title: AMD Ryzen 5 7600X
description: The affordable AM5 entry point. A popular six-core processor offering excellent value for gaming and everyday computing.

title: Intel Core i9-14900K
description: Intel's 14th generation flagship. 24 cores, extremely high clock speeds and enough heat output to double as a room heater.

title: Intel Core i7-14700K
description: A popular high-performance processor with 20 cores. A strong option for gaming, streaming and demanding workloads.

title: Intel Core Ultra 9 285K
description: Intel's Arrow Lake flagship desktop processor. A new architecture and a fresh attempt to redefine high-end desktop performance.

title: Corsair Vengeance DDR5 32GB
description: A staple of modern PC builds. 32GB of DDR5 memory, offering a solid balance of capacity, speed and reliability.

title: G.Skill Trident Z5 Neo DDR5 64GB
description: Premium AMD EXPO memory designed for high-performance Ryzen systems. 64GB for those who refuse to close their browser tabs.

title: Kingston Fury Beast DDR5 32GB
description: A popular memory kit with a clean design and reliable performance. A straightforward upgrade for modern DDR5 systems.

title: Corsair Dominator Titanium DDR5 64GB
description: Premium enthusiast memory. High-end DDR5 performance wrapped in Corsair's flagship Dominator design. Because apparently RAM needs luxury branding too.

title: Crucial Pro DDR5 32GB
description: A practical DDR5 memory kit from a well-known memory manufacturer. No unnecessary extravagance, just dependable desktop memory.

title: G.Skill Ripjaws S5 DDR5 32GB
description: Low-profile DDR5 memory designed for performance-focused builds. A popular choice for enthusiasts who want capable memory without excessive RGB.

title: G.Skill Trident Z5 RGB DDR5 32GB
description: Performance memory with a premium RGB finish. Because even your RAM deserves to look impressive through the glass side panel.
